title: Tip Calculator
description:
A bill of $85.50 is split between 3 people. Calculate an 18% tip on the total bill, then print the total with tip and each person's share. Round everything to 2 decimal places.

**Expected output:**
```
Bill: 85.5
Tip (18%): 15.39
Total with tip: 100.89
Each person pays: 33.63
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
bill = 85.50
tip_rate = 0.18
people = 3
expectedOutput:
Bill: 85.5
Tip (18%): 15.39
Total with tip: 100.89
Each person pays: 33.63
hint: tip = bill * tip_rate, total = bill + tip, per_person = total / people. Use round() for each.
